text: The hourglass whispers, grains slipping through the narrowing funnel, not towards oblivion, but towards a tapestry woven with threads of moments, each one a universe unto itself. Time is not a river, ever flowing, but a vast ocean, its surface shimmering with ripples of past, present, and future, all coexisting in a single, timeless now.  Ask not how time passes, but where it resides, and you may glimpse its secrets.
